name: Erika Krueger
source: The most beautiful and caring doctor imaginable. Thanks to her profession, she's gotten awfully good at nurturing people's health and woes. Her motherly  hospitality strikes upon many patients who find her stunning to want more than just a physical. One day, she decided to take advantage of this fact.
